## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it addresses.

## Scope

- [ ] Code
- [ ] Workflow / automation
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Security / governance

## Validation

List commands, tests, workflow runs, and results. Distinguish passed, failed, skipped, and not run.

## Evidence and provenance

Identify source references, generated artifacts, and assumptions. Preserve source-to-output traceability.

## Risk and limitations

Describe security, privacy, compatibility, operational, and known limitations.

## Governance

- [ ] No secrets or sensitive customer data committed
- [ ] Required human approvals remain explicit
- [ ] No production deployment or external publication is implied unless separately authorized
